summary.plain: The first Beijing Spectrometer, the detector at the Beijing Electron-Positron Collider from 1989 to 1995. In March 1992 it published its first physics paper, a precision measurement of the tau lepton mass that removed doubts about lepton universality.
summary.technical: BESI at BEPC (tau-charm region): central drift chamber (CDC) inside a main drift chamber (MDC), electromagnetic calorimeter of self-quenching streamer tubes interleaved with lead; operated 1989-1995, then upgraded to BESII; first physics paper March 1992 (tau mass).
